Deathstar PG.source: SULFUR 1.0 patch notes, 2026-10-28: "Deathstar PG damage multiplayer is now 1.2 (changed from 1)." The wiki infobox has the new damage (1.0.6 game files, 2026-11-11) but its Caliber Modding table still has the old multiplier; each row is the caliber's base damage times the weapon multiplier. Also: SULFUR 1.0.6 game files (Steam build 26490055): WeaponSO spreadPerCaliber, kickPower and rpm; damage = caliber baseDamage x weapon-type multiplier x damageMultiplier. The wiki's 2026-11-11 bot edits copied the weapon's base Spread attribute, which the game does not use when a per-caliber spread is set (ItemStats.SetSpreadAmountFromDefault).
